basics.description: Deploy the **open weight models on public cloud** reference: an AI Gateway in front of one open weight model on Foundry managed compute, with Application Insights traces and a monthly budget. You get access automatically; callers sign in with Microsoft Entra ID. Global deployment: inference may run in any Azure region, including outside the United States, until Data Zone US is available.

location.label: Resource group region
location.toolTip: Region of the resource group itself. Resources use the Deployment region below.

basics.label: Deployment region
basics.toolTip: Foundry, AI Gateway and monitoring are in East US 2. Inference runs on Global managed compute.

allowedValues.label: East US 2

basics.name: namePrefix
basics.label: Name prefix
basics.toolTip: Short prefix for resource names. A unique suffix is added.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 3 to 8 lowercase letters or digits, starting with a letter.

options.text: One open weight model runs on dedicated accelerators in Foundry managed compute, behind an AI Gateway. Model weights are pinned to a tested release. The serving template (runtime, GPUs, context) follows Microsoft's latest; verify-catalog.sh flags when it moves from the tested version. Managed compute and AI Gateway are in preview. Global deployment: inference may run in any Azure region, including outside the United States, until Data Zone US is available.

allowedValues.description: Instruction-tuned multimodal model for reasoning, coding and image understanding. · Apache 2.0

elements.name: costAcknowledged
elements.label: I understand this deployment is billed every hour it runs, as estimated above, and that to stop billing I delete the model deployment first and then the resource group.

options.text: You (the account running this deployment) get the AI Gateway User role automatically, so you can call the model with an Entra token. This deployment grants nobody a direct role on the model in Foundry, so the gateway is the only way in unless someone inherits a Foundry role from the subscription or resource group. Optionally grant one more user, group or service principal. To find an object ID, run: az ad user show --id <email> --query id -o tsv

elements.name: principalId
elements.label: Additional object ID (optional)
elements.toolTip: Entra object ID of another user, group or service principal to grant the AI Gateway User role.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter an object ID (GUID) or leave it empty.

Group

options.text: Every call is traced to Application Insights. Payload capture is off by default, so prompt and completion text is not stored; token usage is still in Foundry metrics. Turning it on adds token usage and the serving model to traces, and stores request and response text.

elements.name: payloadCapture
elements.label: Capture request and response payloads in traces (adds token usage and model to traces; stores prompt and completion text)

elements.name: reportStatus
elements.label: Report deployment status to the Sovereign AI site, so it can follow this deployment and open its next steps (sends tenant, subscription, resource group and deployment names, your Entra object ID and the next-steps links)
